favorites.emptyMoviesBody: Tap the heart on a movie poster to keep it here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.localNote: Your tracking stays on this device.
profile.demoNote: These controls are for testing a new user and a populated library. Remove them before release.
profile.demoOff: You are using your own lists.
profile.loadDemoMessage: This replaces your current shows and movies with sample tracking data.
profile.clearMessage: This removes your shows, movies, ratings, and watched episodes from this device.
profile.restartMessage: Your current lists stay until you change them. Onboarding will open next.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Track the series you are watching, the movies you want to see, and the episodes you have finished.
onboarding.tryDemoHint: Loads sample shows and movies so you can explore. A new account stays empty until you add something yourself.
onboarding.showsBody: Search the sample catalog and set how far you have watched. You can skip this step.
onboarding.moviesBody: Save movies you want to watch. You can skip this step.

tv.notFound: This show is not in the catalog.
tv.emptyBody: Add a series you are watching, or browse the catalog to start your list.
tv.unreleasedNote: Upcoming episodes stay locked until their air date.

movies.emptyBody: Save a movie you want to watch, or mark one you have already seen.
movies.watchedEmptyBody: Movies you mark as watched will appear here.
movies.notFound: This movie is not in the catalog.

watchlist.moviesNote: Movies you have not watched yet.
watchlist.emptyShowsBody: Series you want to start will show up here.
watchlist.emptyMoviesBody: Movies you want to watch will show up here.

discover.emptyBody: Try another title or switch between TV shows and movies.

archive.emptyMoviesBody: Movies you finish will appear here.

synopsis.harborLights: A harbor inspector follows a missing-cargo case that keeps pulling her back to the night shift.
synopsis.northline: A remote rail town unravels when the winter line starts running trains that were never scheduled.
synopsis.glassArchive: Researchers in a sealed library discover that the catalog is changing the people who read it.
synopsis.emberCourt: An ended family saga about a fading gallery and the last heirs who refuse to sell it.
synopsis.kinfolk: Three siblings return to a family farm and find the old harvest rules still in force.
synopsis.paperSaints: A choir school hides a ledger of favors that every student is expected to repay.
synopsis.afterglow: Night-shift photographers chase a light that appears over the city only after midnight.
synopsis.neonDistrict: Couriers in a flooded entertainment district trade secrets between blackouts.
synopsis.wren: A completed nature mystery about a researcher who maps a migration that should not exist.
synopsis.midnightCensus: Night clerks count the residents of a hospital wing that never appears on the day roster.
synopsis.violetMeridian: A pianist returns home and finds her old duet partner living under another name.
synopsis.lowOrbit: A repair crew on a quiet satellite discovers a passenger who was never on the manifest.
synopsis.saltSilver: Two estranged divers search a closed mine for a camera that recorded their last descent.
synopsis.goldenHour: A travel writer and a projectionist spend one summer restoring a seaside cinema.
synopsis.lastProjectionist: The final employee of a closing movie palace decides which print is worth saving.
synopsis.riverOfStatic: A radio host follows a signal that only plays recordings of places that no longer exist.
synopsis.winterSignal: A cartographer crosses a frozen range to deliver a map nobody admits they ordered.
